_comment: Copy this to config.json and fill in the four values. That file is gitignored
and the app never writes to it.
THIS FILE HOLDS SECRETS IN PLAIN TEXT. Anyone who can read config.json can
post as your bot and spend your Azure quota. Don't put it in a screenshot, a
shared folder, or a repo. Obfuscating it would be fake security on a file in
your own directory, so it isn't obfuscated -- just treat it like a password.
Every value is optional. Anything left out or left empty falls back to an
environment variable, so you can mix the two: put the channel here and keep
the token in CHATMOB_TWITCH_TOKEN if you prefer.
CHATMOB_ environment variable  ->  this file  ->  default
Delete the _comment key if you like; the app ignores keys it doesn't know.
